ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels comprising approximately 85-90% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized at distal tips and peduncle insertion.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottling concentrated at the far-left and far-right distal tips; a vertical high-intensity white band at the ventral peduncle insertion point; sparse white punctate spots scattered across the medial dark regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central notch with an estimated interior angle of 45-55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along both lobes; prominent indentation on the upper medial boundary of the left lobe; jagged peaks and valleys localized along the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve leading to acute, dorsally-swept distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of circular high-intensity pixel groups on the far lateral margins of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular white scarring and depigmentation along the entire trailing edge and distal margins.
